steps.title: Draw the base face
steps.body: Use Rectangle to create a simple base face on the ground plane. Keep the shape small and centered.

steps.title: Activate Push/Pull
steps.body: Choose Push/Pull from the modification tools. Pick the face and move upward along its normal.

steps.title: Commit the height
steps.body: Click or enter a numeric distance to finish the extrusion. The result should read as a simple box.

actions.description: Manual modeling step until pointer playback is wired.

success.description: Future automated check for new side/top faces.

steps.title: Inspect the box
steps.body: Orbit around the box and verify that the top and side faces are visible.

actions.description: Use orbit overview when the webcomponent camera API is available.

success.prompt: The model reads as a simple extruded solid.
